browserValidation.environment: memory-only Go fixture, synthetic accounts, in-app browser after user unlocked Mac
checks: Move confirmation explains preservation and no remote Sub2 deletion; Escape cancels and returns focus to trigger.
Double-click move confirmation submits exactly one POST and removes the synthetic account row.
Same normalized email moves together: archived-job-1 and archived-job-2 remain one recycle entry with two historical jobs.
Historical logs load 500 then 620 retained records; first and last records exist; double-click earlier-page button is deduplicated.
Switching historical job resets the log identity; previous job entries are absent.
Restore confirmation describes no login/authorization/upload; restore returns the account and removes its trash entry.
Final single-click move focuses account-list H2; restore and purge focus recycle-list H2.
Failed purge preserves the record and diagnostic notice; final single-click flow restores the enabled original button.
Purge Escape cancellation keeps data and returns focus; single-click and double-click confirmations submit one request per intended operation.
Narrow dialog is 366px within 390px page; Shift+Tab/Tab cycles between confirm/cancel; Escape closes it.
Unknown move receipt shows a warning and the verified moved row; no automatic mutation replay.
Retention input rejects 1.5 with native stepMismatch before PUT; 30-day confirmation can cancel without losing draft.
Saved 30-day policy persists after page reload and closing/reopening the test tab.
Dirty policy navigation requires a choice; Continue editing preserves draft; 0 disables automatic cleanup.
Enabling a 1-day policy shows existing-record immediate-purge warning; cancel leaves policy unchanged.
Unknown policy save keeps cleanup paused; GET does not acknowledge durability; explicit same-value save confirmation clears the warning.
With synthetic service unavailable, older-log load retains 500 records and explicitly pauses automatic updates.
After service recovery, explicit log refresh preserves latest 500 records, clears failure/pause status and resumes polling (request count increases).
Warm-gray wide layout and dark narrow layout inspected; long synthetic email wraps; narrow Tab scrolls to row actions.
Final browser error/warning log read returns no runtime entries.
notValidated: No production account actions or upstream integrations were used for UI validation.
Actual time-driven expiry uses backend clock tests; the disposable browser fixture does not represent a long-running production scheduler.
Other operating systems were cross-compiled, not natively UI-tested.
